  (AB BC AC : Line)
  (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC)
  (h2 : between b c d₁)

  -- Since angle BAC is one of the internal angles of triangle ABC, and BDC is an external angle formed by extending BC,
  -- angle BDC is greater than angle BAC due to the properties of triangle angles and their extensions.
  <;> linarith [h1]
  <;> linarith [h2]
  <;> linarith [h3]
  <;> linarith [h4]
  <;> linarith [h5]
  <;> linarith [h6]
